item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meera's mother places a piece of solid ghee in a pan and heats it gently. The ghee becomes a liquid.

Which statement best explains why the ghee melts, and how its melting point is identified?

options.A: Heating makes the particles vibrate more strongly until they can leave their fixed positions; the melting point is the lowest temperature, at atmospheric pressure, at which the solid ghee becomes a liquid.
options.B: Heating makes the particles stop vibrating so they can flow; the melting point is the temperature at which the liquid ghee begins to boil.
options.C: Heating creates new particles that fill the gaps; the melting point is any temperature listed for ghee in a table of data.
options.D: Heating makes the particles larger so they push apart; the melting point is the highest temperature the solid ghee can reach before burning.
